heading: Sign in
subtext: Enter the email or phone number you signed up with.

identifier.label: Email or phone number
identifier.required: Enter your email or phone number.
identifier.invalid: Enter a valid email or an 11-digit phone number.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email/phone or password is incorrect.
errors.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rateLimitedGeneric: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
errors.noMemberships: This account isn't linked to a school yet. Contact your school administrator.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

activate.consumed: This link has already been used.
activate.revoked: This link is no longer valid.
activate.missingToken: This link is incomplete — ask for a new one.
activate.linkExplanation: Ask whoever invited you for a new link, or request one yourself with your email or phone number below.
activate.resendDone: If that account needs a new link, one has been sent.
activate.subtext: Choose a password to switch on your account.

forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtext: Enter the email or phone number you signed up with. We'll text a code to a phone or email a link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent.
forgot.codeSubtext: If that phone is on an account, we sent it a 6-digit code. No code after a few tries? Wait an hour, then try again.
forgot.invalidLink: This link is incomplete — ask for a new one.
forgot.linkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used.
forgot.linkExplanation: Ask for a new one from "Forgot password?".

errors.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or has expired.

forgot.sentExplanation: Open the link in that email to choose a new password. If it hasn't arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

verifyEmail.missingToken: This link is incomplete — ask for a new one.
verifyEmail.linkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used.
verifyEmail.linkExplanation: Request the change again from your account page.
verifyEmail.success: Your contact details have been updated.

proposal.title: {{school}} wants to change your contact details
proposal.explanation: Approve only if you expect this. Nothing changes until you press Approve.
proposal.declined: Declined. Nothing was changed, and {{school}} has been told.
proposal.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
proposal.codeTitle: Enter the code we sent to the new contact
proposal.codeExplanation: We sent a 6-digit code to the new email or phone. Nothing changes until you enter it. No code? The new contact may be wrong, so press Decline.
proposal.codeError: That code didn't work. Check it, or open the link again to get a new code.
proposal.withdrawn: This change can no longer be made. The school may have withdrawn it. Nothing was changed.
proposal.conflict: This change can't be made right now: the new email or phone is already used by another account, or the change would leave you with no email or phone. Nothing was changed.
proposal.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then open the link again to get a new code.
proposal.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
proposal.unavailable: We couldn't send or check the code just now. Try again in a minute.

otp.subtext: Enter the mobile number or email on your account. We'll send you a code.
otp.codeSentTo: If {{phone}} is on an account, we sent it a 6-digit code. No code after a few tries? Wait an hour, then try again.
otp.changeNumber: Use a different number or email

errors.invalidCode: That number, email or code is incorrect.

schoolPicker.heading: Choose a school
schoolPicker.subtext: You belong to more than one school. Pick the one you're working in now.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account.
sessions.confirmAllBody: This ends every session, including this one. You'll need to sign in again.
sessions.empty: You're only signed in on this device.
sessions.revokedToast: That device has been signed out.
sessions.error: Couldn't load your sessions. Please try again.

reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.subtext: You'll use it to sign in from now on.

passwordTooLong: Use a shorter password — at most 72 letters, or 24 Bangla letters.

login.firstTime: First time here? Sign in with a code
login.socialNotLinked: That account is not connected yet. Sign in with a code, then connect it from your account page.

firstPassword.heading: Set a password
firstPassword.subtext: Add a password so you can sign in without a code next time.

none.title: You are not in any school yet
none.body: Ask your school's admin to add you.
